The one-ROUTED-history-row requirement of F003 is not re-verified here over a live GET: GET /api/tickets/{id} is not a Group A story (it is scoped to Group D's E6-S1 agent workbench per specs/stories/sprint-4.md) and does not exist yet. It is verified at the repository/API layer by backend/tests/integration/test_create_ticket_api.py::test_AC02_F003_billing_technical_account_route_to_matching_queue_with_one_routed_row, which asserts the ticket_history row directly. api_checks.description: AC-02: when the routing rule for a ticket's category has been removed (test fixture deletes the Billing RoutingRule row before this request), the create request returns 409 ROUTING_RULE_MISSING and writes no ticket row. layering.description: Backend code under backend/src/ follows the strict one-way layering Types/Models -> Config -> Repository -> Service -> API -> UI, with business rules confined to backend/src/domain. Verified by `uv run lint-imports` passing against the import-linter contract with zero violations.

typing.description: Backend source is statically typed with zero use of Any and passes `uv run mypy src/` in strict mode. SLA timer fields (response/resolution minutes) are integer types only, never float, per NFR-01 and E1-S1 AC3.

folder_structure.description: backend/src/ contains the expected top-level layer folders (types, config, repository, service, api, domain) matching the architecture in .claude/architecture.md and specs/design/component-map.md, with no cross-layer imports that bypass the declared boundaries.
